findings.description: Editing an expense drops the cents of the amount: saving 42.50 stores $42.00, 12.34 becomes $12.00, 5.5 becomes $5.00, 0.99 becomes $0.00. The list row and total then show the truncated value, and it persists after reload. Adding an expense keeps cents correctly (7.25 stays $7.25).
repro: Change the amount to 12.34 (or re-save 42.50) and click Save expense
Observe the list row shows $12.00 (or $42.00) and the total is computed from the truncated amount; reload and it stays truncated

notes: Total vs sum, category filter, add (single row, flash, persistence), viewer read-only (UI and direct GET/POST refused with 403) all behaved correctly. Very large amounts (99999999999) are accepted without an upper bound; not reported.

cost.notes: estimate from 26180 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0052-$0.0628
